{{Top|leg}}
'''Velmstone''' was a mineral substance found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. The planet's inhabitants used the material in the construction of their buildings, as its resilience rivaled [[Permacrete/Legends|permacrete]].
